evidence: Across 89 out-of-time company-year forecasts, next-year operating-cash-flow MAE was 3.08% of opening assets for cash persistence and 3.07% for the accrual model.
next_decision: Investigate persistent cash-collection gaps alongside the audited note, industry and fiscal period. Use issuer-specific balance-sheet classifications before applying a valuation haircut.
boundary: Predictive associations in a selected panel do not establish manipulation or causality. Vendor non-trade receivables are distinct from customer trade balances. Scenario valuations depend on payout, opening book, abnormal-return persistence and cost of equity.
